websiteFaqHeading.description: Heading of the FAQ section on the support page.

websiteFaqRestrictedQuestion.message: Why doesn't SiteMark work on some pages?
websiteFaqRestrictedQuestion.description: FAQ question about restricted pages where extensions can't run.

websiteFaqRestrictedAnswer.message: Browsers don't let extensions run on their own pages (such as settings or a new tab), on the extension stores, in the PDF viewer or on local files. On those pages the popup says that SiteMark can't run there.

websiteFaqPermissionQuestion.message: Why does SiteMark ask for permission when I add a URL pattern?
websiteFaqPermissionQuestion.description: FAQ question about the permission prompt.

websiteFaqPermissionAnswer.message: SiteMark has no access to any website when you install it. When you add a pattern, it asks for access to just the websites that pattern matches, so it can show your marks there on every visit. If you say no, the pattern stays with an Allow button, so you can grant access later.
websiteFaqPermissionAnswer.description: FAQ answer about the permission prompt.

websiteFaqMarksQuestion.message: My marks don't show up. What can I check?
websiteFaqMarksQuestion.description: FAQ question about marks that don't show.

websiteFaqMarksAnswer.message: Open the SiteMark popup on that page. It shows which site groups match, whether they are enabled and whether SiteMark has access to the website. Allow access if it asks, and reload the page. An element mark also needs its element on the page: the popup says when it isn't found.
websiteFaqMarksAnswer.description: FAQ answer about marks that don't show.

websiteFaqHideQuestion.message: How do I hide marks for a demo or a screenshot?

websiteFaqHideAnswer.message: Choose Hide on this tab in the popup. The marks come back when you reload the page, leave the website or close the tab. You can also give this a keyboard shortcut in your browser's extension shortcut settings.
websiteFaqHideAnswer.description: FAQ answer about hiding marks on one tab.

websiteFaqDataQuestion.message: Where are my site groups stored?
websiteFaqDataQuestion.description: FAQ question about where data lives.

websiteFaqDataAnswer.message: Only in your browser, in the extension's local storage. SiteMark never sends them anywhere and doesn't sync them. To move them to another browser or device, use export and import on the options page.
websiteFaqDataAnswer.description: FAQ answer about where data lives.

websiteFaqRemoveQuestion.message: How do I remove all my data?
websiteFaqRemoveQuestion.description: FAQ question about removing all data.

websiteFaqRemoveAnswer.message: Use Reset everything on the options page, or remove the extension from your browser. Both delete your site groups and settings. Tab titles with a prefix can still be in your browser history; clear them there.
websiteFaqRemoveAnswer.description: FAQ answer about removing all data.
